    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【YOLOv12实战】寥寥数行代码实现目标跟踪与速度估计，新手也能轻松搞定！</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">

        【YOLOv12实战】寥寥数行代码实现目标跟踪与速度估计，新手也能轻松搞定！
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></p>
<h1 id="%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA">视频演示</h1>
<p id="%E7%BB%93%E8%AF%AD-toc"><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1u9a2z1EjS" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">【YOLOv12实战】寥寥数行代码实现目标跟踪与速度估计，新手也能轻松搞定！</a></p>
<p>大家好，这里是Coding茶水间。今天分享一个超简单的教程：如何使用YOLO算法，只需几行代码，就能实现目标跟踪和速度估计。</p>
<p>新手小白也能轻松上手！这个方法基于Ultralytics的YOLO框架，结合OpenCV处理视频，效果超级实用。</p>
<p>废话不多说，我们直接从头开始敲代码。整个过程简单明了，只需要导入两个包，就能完成视频中的车辆和行人速度估计演示。</p>
<h1 id="%E7%8E%AF%E5%A2%83%E5%87%86%E5%A4%87">环境准备</h1>
<p>本次演示基于YOLOv12的最新算法运行环境。大家可以去Ultralytics官网下载最新版本，这里不再赘述。环境包括我这里用到的Python 3.10、Ultralytics包和OpenCV。确保你已经提前下载YOLOv12的预训练权重文件（yolo12n.pt）。</p>
<h1 id="%E6%AD%A5%E9%AA%A4%E8%AF%A6%E8%A7%A3">步骤详解</h1>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%80%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BAPython%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6">第一步：创建Python文件</h2>
<p>新建一个Python文件，命名为speed_estimator.py（或者随便你喜欢的名字）。</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%8C%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%AF%BC%E5%85%A5%E5%BF%85%E8%A6%81%E7%9A%84%E5%8C%85">第二步：导入必要的包</h2>
<p>我们只需要导入Ultralytics的solutions模块中的speed_estimation，以及OpenCV用于视频处理。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22from%20ultralytics.solutions%20import%20speed_estimation%5Cnimport%20cv2%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>from ultralytics.solutions import speed_estimation
import cv2</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>ultralytics.solutions.speed_estimation：这是YOLO框架提供的速度估计模块，超级方便。</li>
<li>cv2：OpenCV库，用于读取和处理视频。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%B8%89%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91">第三步：读取视频</h2>
<p>使用OpenCV的VideoCapture方法加载视频文件。这里假设你的视频文件名为speed_hd.mp4，路径可以根据实际情况调整。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cncap%20%3D%20cv2.VideoCapture(%5C%22speed_hd.mp4%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code># 读取视频
cap = cv2.VideoCapture("speed_hd.mp4")</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<p>这个cap变量就是视频捕获对象，我们后续会用它逐帧读取图像。</p>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E5%9B%9B%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%88%9B%E5%BB%BA%E9%80%9F%E5%BA%A6%E4%BC%B0%E8%AE%A1%E5%AF%B9%E8%B1%A1">第四步：创建速度估计对象</h2>
<p>初始化一个SpeedEstimator对象，这是核心部分。传递几个关键参数：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22speed_obj%20%3D%20speed_estimation.SpeedEstimator(%5Cn%5Cnmodel%20%3D%20%5C%22yolo12n.pt%5C%22%2C%20%23%20%E6%8C%87%E5%AE%9A%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%EF%BC%88YOLOv12%E9%A2%84%E8%AE%AD%E7%BB%83%E6%9D%83%E9%87%8D%EF%BC%89%5Cn%5Cnshow%20%3D%20True%2C%20%23%20%E6%98%AF%E5%90%A6%E5%B1%95%E7%A4%BA%E4%B8%AD%E9%97%B4%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C%5Cn%5Cnmeter_per_pixel%20%3D%200.3%20%23%20%E6%AF%8F%E5%83%8F%E7%B4%A0%E5%AF%B9%E5%BA%94%E7%9A%84%E5%AE%9E%E9%99%85%E8%B7%9D%E7%A6%BB%EF%BC%88%E7%B1%B3%EF%BC%89%5Cn%5Cn)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>speed_obj = speed_estimation.SpeedEstimator(

model = "yolo12n.pt", # 指定模型（YOLOv12预训练权重）

show = True, # 是否展示中间处理效果

meter_per_pixel = 0.3 # 每像素对应的实际距离（米）

)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>model：指定YOLO模型的权重文件。这里用yolo12n.pt，这是YOLOv12的nano版本，轻量高效。你可以替换成其他版本如yolo12s.pt等。</li>
<li>show：设置为True，表示在处理过程中实时显示速度估计效果。如果设置为False，你可以自己处理结果。</li>
<li>meter_per_pixel：这是一个关键参数！它定义了视频中一个像素对应实际世界的多少米（类似于地图比例尺）。这里设为0.3米/像素，根据你的视频拍摄距离和相机参数调整这个值，能让速度估计更准确。视频中的速度是基于像素移动距离模拟的，所以这个转换关系直接影响结果。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E4%BA%94%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%B8%A7">第五步：处理视频帧</h2>
<p>使用while循环逐帧读取视频，进行速度估计。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cnwhile%20cap.isOpened()%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20success%2C%20im0%20%3D%20cap.read()%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20success%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20break%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20speed_obj(im0)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code># 处理视频
while cap.isOpened():
    success, im0 = cap.read()

    if not success:
        break

    results = speed_obj(im0)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>cap.isOpened()：检查视频是否还能读取。</li>
<li>cap.read()：读取一帧图像，返回成功标志success和图像im0。</li>
<li>如果读取失败，就跳出循环。</li>
<li>speed_obj(im0)：直接把图像传入速度估计对象，它会自动进行目标检测、跟踪和速度计算。因为show=True，它会实时显示结果，包括车辆或行人的速度（单位：km/h 或类似）。</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="%E7%AC%AC%E5%85%AD%E6%AD%A5%EF%BC%9A%E9%87%8A%E6%94%BE%E8%B5%84%E6%BA%90">第六步：释放资源</h2>
<p>处理完视频后，释放视频对象并关闭窗口。</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22cap.release()%5Cncv2.waitKey(0)%5Cncv2.destroyAllWindows()%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>cap.release()
cv2.waitKey(0)
cv2.destroyAllWindows()</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>cap.release()：释放视频捕获资源。</li>
<li>cv2.waitKey(0)：等待用户按键，防止程序立即退出，便于查看最终状态。</li>
<li>cv2.destroyAllWindows()：关闭所有OpenCV窗口。</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="%E5%AE%8C%E6%95%B4%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81">完整代码</h1>
<p>把以上部分组合起来，就是完整的脚本：</p>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22from%20ultralytics.solutions%20import%20speed_estimation%5Cnimport%20cv2%5Cn%5Cn%23%E8%AF%BB%E5%8F%96%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cncap%20%3D%20cv2.VideoCapture(%5C%22speed_hd.mp4%5C%22)%5Cn%5Cnspeed_obj%20%3D%20speed_estimation.SpeedEstimator(%5Cn%20%20%20%20model%20%3D%20%5C%22yolo12n.pt%5C%22%2C%20%23%E6%8C%87%E5%AE%9A%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cn%20%20%20%20show%20%3D%20True%2C%5Cn%20%20%20%20meter_per_pixel%20%3D%200.3%20%23%E6%AF%8F%E5%83%8F%E7%B4%A0%E5%AF%B9%E5%BA%94%E7%9A%84%E7%B1%B3%E6%95%B0%5Cn)%5Cn%5Cn%23%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5Cnwhile%20cap.isOpened()%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20success%2C%20im0%20%3D%20cap.read()%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20success%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20break%5Cn%5Cn%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20speed_obj(im0)%5Cn%5Cn%5Cncap.release()%5Cncv2.waitKey(0)%5Cncv2.destroyAllWindows()%5Cn%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>from ultralytics.solutions import speed_estimation
import cv2

#读取视频
cap = cv2.VideoCapture("speed_hd.mp4")

speed_obj = speed_estimation.SpeedEstimator(
    model = "yolo12n.pt", #指定模型
    show = True,
    meter_per_pixel = 0.3 #每像素对应的米数
)

#处理视频
while cap.isOpened():
    success, im0 = cap.read()

    if not success:
        break

    results = speed_obj(im0)


cap.release()
cv2.waitKey(0)
cv2.destroyAllWindows()</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<h1 id="%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C">运行效果</h1>
<p>运行这个脚本后，它会打开视频窗口，实时显示检测到的目标（车辆、行人等），并在每个目标上标注速度估计值。效果如视频演示：对路边车辆和行人进行跟踪，计算模拟速度。</p>
<p><img alt="识别效果截图" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250904163426965-1542663339.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>注意事项：</p>
<ul>
<li>速度估计基于像素移动，不是真实速度数据，所以有一定误差。调整meter_per_pixel可以优化精度。</li>
<li>如果视频中物体移动太快或太慢，模型可能需要微调。</li>
<li>环境问题：如果报错（如模型路径不对），检查权重文件是否下载正确。YOLOv12是最新版，性能比之前的YOLOv8更强。</li>
</ul>
<h1 id="%E7%BB%93%E8%AF%AD">结语</h1>
<p>通过这个简单教程，你可以看到YOLO框架的强大——只需寥寥数行代码，就能实现目标跟踪和速度估计！适合入门AI视觉项目。</p>
<p>有问题欢迎留言讨论，一起交流学习！Coding茶水间，下期见~</p>
